summary: HF Sinclair Corporation filed an 8-K reporting a $100 million share repurchase from REH Advisors Inc. in a privately negotiated transaction. The company will buy 1,455,180 shares at $68.72 per share, funded with cash on hand, with the shares held as treasury stock. The repurchase is the twenty-first such deal with the selling stockholder and is made under the previously authorized $1 billion share repurchase program, which has now seen $717 million in total buybacks. Completion is expected around May 21, 2026. No premium or board recommendation is specified. The transaction reduces overhang from a major stockholder and signals ongoing capital return. Watch for future repurchase pace under the program and any potential continuation of buybacks from REH.
